policies.text: A rail operator gains express line access privileges provided the carrier maintains a Class A safety license.
A logistics provider is chosen for executive transfer management if the transport vendor achieves regional partnership at the preferred carrier level.
A freight agency gains fast-track customs authorization when maintaining a minimum warehouse capacity of 50000 square meters.
An aviation service firm satisfies core flight supplier criteria if annual flight completions total at least 250 flights.
A maritime carrier secures premier harbor dispatch status when quarterly freight tonnage reaches at least 10000 metric tons.
A transport vendor achieves regional partnership at the preferred carrier level by maintaining an active fleet size of at least 40 vehicles or securing ISO 39001 road traffic safety accreditation.
A rental vehicle business achieves prime terminal placement upon maintaining an annual traveler satisfaction score of 95 percent.
